[EN] Forsil's desperate for barbed diamonds. All my resources are hunting down eldritch shards, or I'd help.

Do you think you could gather some? They're not hard to find and Forsil's known to pay well. They're common south of Bleakrock and north of the Azurice Shrine.
[ES] Forsil está desesperado por barbed diamonds. Todos mis recursos están cazando fragmentos arcanos, o si no ayudaría.

¿Crees que podrías conseguir algunos? No son difíciles de encontrar y se sabe que Forsil paga bien. Son comunes al sur de Bleakrock y al norte del Azurice Shrine.

[EN] Ah, you brought me diamonds. The snows must be stained red indeed if you got these from under the Junaidars' noses.

Cut properly, these will sell well to arcanists and jewelers. Thank you indeed!
[ES] Ah, trajiste diamonds. Las nieves deben estar teñidas de rojo de verdad si conseguiste esto de las narices de los Junaidars.

Cortados correctamente, se venderán bien a los arcanistas y joyeros. ¡Muchas gracias!

[EN] If you don't have the diamonds, I don't have the time.
[ES] Si no tienes los Diamonds, no tengo tiempo.
